tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.

It rests on two current records: #23, "verification on all builds", and #26, "https everywhere, no exceptions". I left out the retired record that let dev builds skip verification.

An earlier session also has a remark, "plain http for internal hosts". That is only a transcript excerpt, not a decision record, and #26 is newer and says no exceptions. I did not use it. If you want internal hosts exempted, that needs a new decision.

Muninn also reports a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That may mean a hook is timing out. It did not affect this task.
